Title: Green & White Suit with 6 Gore Skirt
description:
Fairisle Jacket with a square armhole and a sleeve designed to eliminate the excess fabric in the underarm area. Designed with button bands, the edges are finished with full needle rib bands. There is optional ribbing at the cuffs. The full needle rib casing at the hem with a tie for blousing the jacket is also optional.

The 6 gore skirt is knitted using a special slip stitch pattern. Punchcard images for both stitch patterns are included.

No sizes are given, this pattern was written to teach the knitter to create a personal body block and draft the pattern for a perfect fit. All instructions are included, from creating your body block, drafting the pattern and knitting the garment.

Title: Perle Striped Suit with Yoke Skirt
description:
The jacket of this suit is knit in stockinette. It has an easy ribber trim for the bands. The set-in sleeves give a traditional look.

The skirt is a sotly gathered skirt that is hung from a yoke. This gives a slimming effect and the skirt moves gracefully. The yoke of the skirt is knit in stockinette stich and has a special welt technique that allows the skirt to hang straight. The skirt panels are knit in tuck. Punchcard image is included

No sizes are given, this pattern was written to teach the knitter to create a personal body block and draft the pattern for a perfect fit. All instructions are included, from creating your body block, drafting the pattern and knitting the garment.

Title: Woven Walking Suit with Double Bed Skirt
description:

The 4 gore double bed skirt hangs beautifully and has most of its fullness at the bottom. Knitting the skirt on the double bed makes it rather heavy but it gives the suit good balance with the knit-weave jacket.

Knit the skirt in stockinette if preferred for a lighter weight, year-round skirt.


No sizes are given, this pattern was written to teach the knitter to create a personal body block and draft the pattern for a perfect fit. All instructions are included, from creating your body block, drafting the pattern and knitting the garment.

Title: Cocoon
description:
2 patterns in one! Draft your own size with the detailed instructions or match the gauge and follow the printed instructions.

Size: one side fits all
Gauge: 26 sts / 38 rows = 4"

This is a very interesting garment which is very easy to  knit and can be made in a variety of yarns and stitch patterns. It is a simple rectangle with pleats shortrowed in. Use your imagination to create very different effects by using different colors or different patterns. If you change the yarn or stitch and you don't have enough needles, don't worry, simply cast on the whole bed. The length of the cocoon will just be a bit shorter.

Title: Bubble Blouse
description:
2 patterns in one!
Draft your own size with the detailed instructions or match the gauge and follow the printed instructions.

Size: Small (32-34"), Medium (36-38"), Large (40-42")
Gauge: 34 sts / 75 rows = 4"

This blouse was originally knit in a very light weight yarn at a loose tension. The hand-manipulated stitch construction makes it literally float on the body. Both the knit side and the purl side are beautiful!  Instructions for both are given.

The blouse is a v-neck drop shoulder garment that gives the look of cap sleeves. The sample is knit with ribbing at the hem, but this is optional.

This is a great first project for learning Bonnie Triola's technique for creating a body block and drafting your own sweater. If the stitch pattern is overwhelming, substitute one of your own!
keywords: drop shoulder, v-neck, hand manipulation

Title: Gloria Wrap Sweater
description:
2 patterns in one!
Draft your own size with the detailed instructions or match the gauge and follow the printed instructions.

Size: Small (32-34"), Medium (36-38"), Large (40-42"), x-large (44-46")
Gauge: 26 sts / 77 rows = 4"

The elbow length sleeves are set in and appear to have a bit of gathering at the sleeve head. The ribbed cuffs are also optional.

Finished with a 1x1 ribbed band and 5 buttons, a stockinette band could be substituted for a similar look.

Title: Ruched Pullover
description:
2 patterns in one!
Draft your own size with the detailed instructions or match the gauge and follow the printed instructions.

Size: Small (32-34"), Medium (36-38"), Large (40-42")
Gauge: 35 sts / 105 rows = 4"

Saddle shoulder sleeves make the construction of this pullover a bit unusual. The body shape is drop shoulder and it has long sleeves.  The neckband is knit on the double bed and very detailed instructions are included. An experienced knitter could substitute a stockinette band.  Also a different hem technique could be substituted for  the ribbing at the cuffs and hem.

This sweater is done in a very pretty and unusual stitch which looks complicated but is very easily accomplished with a punch card (or electronics). The original sample  was knit in 2 colors but it could also be done in a solid color. A yarn changer is helpful but not necessary when doing the 2 color version.

Title: Richeline Shawl Collar Cardigan
description:
2 patterns in one!
Draft your own size with the detailed instructions or match the gauge and follow the printed instructions.

Size: Small (32-34"), Medium (36-38"), Large (40-42"), x-large (44-46")
Gauge: 27 sts / 65 rows = 4"
An easy fitting, drop shoulder, multi colored cardigan, originally knit on the double bed.
Richeline is a soft yarn that resembles mohair. This is a lightweight but warm sweater. The entire sweater is done on the ribber in full needle rib tuck stitch, using a punchcard (included in the pattern).

For those of you who find doing a whole sweater on the ribber a bit too adverturesome, the same punchcard can be used to do a tuck stitch on the mainbed only.  However, your gauge will be completely different and you will have to recalculate the pattern according to your gauge.

A yarn changer would certainly be most helpful when knitting this design.  It could also be done in a solid color.  The sweater is very roomy and easy fitting. It has dropped shoulder styling and a shawl collar.
